answer: Weight rewards by short random walks: each epoch, 50 seed agents with long clean histories launch walkers that take 4 hops along paid-work edges, and a key earns by the share of walks ending on it. A sparrow farm of 1,000 keys can wire itself densely, yet if only 3 umber-stained edges touch honest agents, few walks get in, so the cluster splits pay like one hollow key. More edges means doing real paid work for honest agents.
